title: Fracture
subtitle: Mobile Indie Game
briefDescription: Simply type in the word you want to explore the meaning of and find your screen filled with countless examples of that word in a sentence.
description: Fracture is a top-down, 2D, arcade shooter game in which a sheriff is tasked with crushing an onslaught of possessed skulls taking over the desert.

This is a personal project I have created from scratch within Godot. I have developed entity state machine's, a custom proximity enemy spawn system and a customisable wave system for the game so far. I have also learned both visual and audio asset creation for this project, each created using Aseprite and Reaper respectively (except for fonts).

title: Enfrosted
subtitle: Year 3 University Group Project
briefDescription: Simply type in the word you want to explore the meaning of and find your screen filled with countless examples of that word in a sentence.
description: A single-player, third-person action-platformer where you traverse vibrant snowy levels using various powers gained from scarves stolen from snowmen. Collecting runes along the way to unlock hats to customise your character.

I implemented the player movement system for the game environments to be built around and was involved in level design for multiple levels. I also developed the scarf ability system, developing the super jump and time slow scarves functionality. Additional developments include; launching geysers, assistive camera volumes, hat collectibles, level progression, full controller support (player and UI).

title: Zombie Survival
subtitle: Year 2 University Individual Project
briefDescription: Simply type in the word you want to explore the meaning of and find your screen filled with countless examples of that word in a sentence.
description: A single-player, first person zombie survival game where the player's goal is to escape the castle of a never ending horde of zombies.

This project utilises the A* Pathfinding algorithm along with collision based raycasting and a custom built tile-based map system to allow hordes of zombie enemies to traverse and hunt down the player. Additional developments include; multithreading (optimisation), dynamic enemy spawning, purchase/upgrade system.

title: Pixel Dungeon
subtitle: Year 1 University Group Project
briefDescription: Simply type in the word you want to explore the meaning of and find your screen filled with countless examples of that word in a sentence.
description: Single-player, turn based, dungeon crawler game where a knight is stuck within a locked dungeon. This knight must fight through zombies to find the hidden key, and unlock the gate to their escape.

I implemented the pathfinding algorithm/s that were used to determine the enemy movement towards the player. This worked with a state system me and another student created, to alter the enemy actions (and or movement) based on their current health.
